features.name: Portable Docker trial-sandbox adapter with adapter-specific conformance selection
features.description: Add one canonical trusted Docker-backed equivalent adapter implementing ADAPTER --root TRIAL_ROOT --runner RUNNER -- RUNNER_ARGUMENTS... (digest-pinned image, network none, cap-drop all, no-new-privileges, read-only rootfs, same-path bind mounts, inner Landlock via the existing isolated_trial_adapter.py extended with an optional interpreter allowlist), and make sandbox conformance capability selection adapter-specific in the test suite so the five sandbox-dependent obligations exercise for real through the selected adapter while unsupported-stays-nonzero is preserved.
acceptance_tests: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/test_convergent_review.py (auto-selection; restrictive QA host must print CONFORMANCE: FULL via Docker adapter, exit 0)
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/test_convergent_review.py --isolation-adapter tools/docker_trial_sandbox.sh (forced Docker; same FULL/exit 0)
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 .github/scripts/test_sandbox_boundaries.py --adapter tools/docker_trial_sandbox.sh (adapter-flavored live boundary suite, exit 0)

PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/test_convergent_review.py --isolation-adapter tools/linux_trial_sandbox.sh (forced native on restrictive host: exactly the five UNSUPPORTED lines, CONFORMANCE: NOT FULL, exit 1 — unsupported obligation preserved; on a native-capable host this same command must exit 0 with CONFORMANCE: FULL)
bash tools/docker_trial_sandbox.sh --probe && bash tools/docker_trial_sandbox.sh --print-image (capability probe and pinned-image introspection)

acceptance_requirements.live-boundary-not-static: Allowed work really runs: the hermetic fake runner completes three evaluator trials through the Docker adapter (receipt verified). Forbidden work fails for the boundary reason: exec of a chmod-executable file inside the trial root fails EACCES (not ENOENT); a host-existing sibling/ambient file is unreadable inside; a listener proven reachable outside is refused inside. Each layer proven load-bearing by omission controls (exec-permitted mutant exits 42; bad interpreter exits 53; mounted-sibling control reads 40; in-container loopback control connects 41). Static flag checks alone do not satisfy this.
acceptance_requirements.no-capability-session-socket-regressions: Live guards inside the sandboxed trial: effective capabilities zero, no Docker daemon socket path, fresh PID namespace (small pid / container pid 1), and no ambient environment forwarding. The observer receives no runtime-session or control endpoint.
acceptance_requirements.five-obligations-exercised: All five previously UNSUPPORTED evaluator/adapter properties execute under the Docker adapter on the restrictive QA host: three isolated validated trials; per-trial packet copies; cross-trial file and network denial; generated-execution denial; runner substitution rejection.
acceptance_requirements.unsupported-honesty: Forced-native run on the restrictive host still reports exactly the five UNSUPPORTED outcomes, CONFORMANCE: NOT FULL, and exits non-zero; no renamed steps, no metadata resets, no manufactured green. On native-capable hosts the native path remains the default and unchanged.
acceptance_requirements.trust-and-provenance: Wrapper accepts no image/mount/flag input from untrusted sources; image reference is a digest-pinned constant; daemon-unreachable or image-absent fails closed with distinct exits; evaluator receipt still digests the adapter.
acceptance_requirements.existing-bank: All existing component tests, fixture self-test, workflow assurance, validator checks, and the payload validation remain green with no removed assertions.
acceptance_requirements.delivery: Docs/index/CHANGELOG/DEBT/manifest updated; independent Mode A and contract-testability review approved with empty issue arrays before implementation; Mode B, fresh adversarial QA and evidence capture after; bounded draft PR; no merge or release.

features.product_boundary: One new trusted wrapper adapter, an additive optional interpreter-rule flag on the existing inner adapter, adapter-specific capability selection and boundary exercises in the shipped test suite, envelope/CI/docs/index registration. No evaluator/schema/packet/replay/publication changes; no orchestration layer; no host-control changes.

external_prerequisites: Reachable Docker daemon with the digest-pinned public image reference available locally (pulled by an explicit reviewed step; the adapter fails closed when absent)
The five required Docker-adapter conformance controls must run without any host security relaxation
measurement_basis: Live command evidence on the restrictive QA host (apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1) proving the boundary, the omission controls, and the five obligations; plus the unchanged existing bank green.
accounting: Estimate 1100 lines over product 200 / process 300 / tests 600; ceiling 1430. Historical counters preserved; no rebaseline.
